name: Market acceptance

subjectOf.text: Blockchain enabled services should expect the same incumbent resistance that sharing platforms encountered, so technical viability will not by itself produce rapid market acceptance.
subjectOf.abstract: future blockchain-enabled sharing services may not be accepted quickly and without resistance on the part of incumbents challenged by new ways of delivering a service or product.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033
scope_conditions: applies where incumbents are challenged by a new way of delivering an existing service or product

subjectOf.text: Cartelization of the code review industry causes significant overpricing, because clients will pay almost any price to obtain the stamp of approval from one of the top five audit firms.
subjectOf.abstract: As a result of the cartelization of the industry, most code reviews are significantly overpriced. Clients pretty much pay any price to get the stamp of approval from one of the top 5 audit firms.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709
scope_conditions: clients needing market acceptance for their products

subjectOf.text: Because customers cannot afford to search for better priced code reviews and are forced into cartel pricing to obtain market acceptance of their products, cartelization undermines any form of downward price pressure.
subjectOf.abstract: Customers cannot afford to look for better priced code reviews and are forced into the cartel pricing to obtain market acceptance of their products. In turn, the cartelization of the market undermines any form of downward price pressure.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709
scope_conditions: clients requiring market acceptance signals from audit firms
